# Codex CLI 0.164.0 identity

Frozen npm and GitHub identity for official stable `0.164.0` and the
published hops after the `0.161.0` ceiling. Wrapper and native
`darwin-arm64` / `linux-x64` tarballs were hashed and inventoried. No
downloaded vendor binary was executed. Public `rust-v*` tags plus those
hashed artifacts are the behavior authority. `0.165.0-alpha.1` is ignored.
No prompt, login, or live session.

Native packages are parent-package variant versions
(`npm:@openai/codex@VER-darwin-arm64`), not separate registry names.
`0.161.0` native identities reuse Research 370. Complete per-file artifact
inventories live in `artifact-inventory/`. Complete source hop deltas live
in `source-name-status.tsv`.
